bullets.title: ZS: Double downgrade — Macquarie cuts to Neutral, PT $225 from $250
bullets.body: Zscaler received two downgrades on the day: Macquarie moved to Neutral from Outperform and cut its price target to $225 from $250, while Daiwa also downgraded to Neutral from Buy. Consensus is turning more cautious on the name.

bullets.title: AMZN: TEPCO to invest $64B in AI power infrastructure targeting AWS as hyperscaler anchor
bullets.body: TEPCO plans to invest JPY10.2T (~$64B) in power grids and nuclear capacity through FY2030, with the goal of attracting US hyperscaler data centers — Amazon Web Services is cited as a prospective customer. TEPCO targets an 8x increase in data center power supply by FY2027 and 16x by FY2040, with EBITDA (post-decommissioning) nearly doubling to JPY1.4T by FY2035.

bullets.title: Macro: UBS flags AI capex slowdown priced in despite accelerating demand; Fed hiking cycle near end
bullets.body: UBS notes a risk-off episode began Nov 5 following a Blue Sweep, with core PCE at 3.26% and expected to tick up to 3.34% before declining — two more Fed hikes anticipated. AI capex slowdown has been priced by markets even as AI demand accelerates, with UBS flagging policy constraints as a potential supply limiter; global AI and defense spend expected to stay elevated in 2027.
